identity.title: 2D Pipeline Tool 설명자와 안전한 모델 복원

origin.summary: PL-0014 capability matrix priority 1 was explicitly approved for implementation.

state.current_summary: Cause: the Pipeline factory covered only 6 of 15 public 2D Tools and lacked a safe model-artifact contract. Change: PL-0015 added immutable descriptors, explicit package-owned factories for all 15 Tools, schema-2 host-resolved artifact validation, compatibility loading, tests, and guidance. Result: exact local, commit-fixed package, isolated consumer/native-copy, and remote CI gates pass at implementation commit 2e16c7ecb0fa1928b37acf4221061cadd46a4258 without publishing packages.

objective.summary: Make every public non-legacy 2D Tool discoverable and safely reconstructible through package-owned Pipeline factories, including integrity-checked host-resolved templates.
constraints: Preserve direct typed Tool APIs and VisionPipelineRuntime.Run behavior.
Do not persist host file paths, use reflection-based construction/discovery, or introduce global registration.
Keep Vision2D independent of Vision2D.Blob; compose Blob support in the Blob package.
Preserve version 1 and unversioned Pipeline XML readability while versioning the new artifact contract.
Keep UI, acquisition, PLC/MES, NuGet publication, consumer-repository changes, and production qualification out of scope.

criteria.text: Machine-readable descriptors expose canonical IDs, aliases, property identity, parameters/defaults/types, and artifact requirements for all 15 public non-legacy 2D Tools across their owning packages.
Package-owned factories construct all 15 Tools from invariant validated parameters without reflection or global registration, and reject unsupported or malformed values deterministically.

Matching, edge-based matching, and SIFT templates are reconstructed from host-resolved encoded bytes only after stable ID, format version, and SHA-256 validation; decoded Mats and created Tools have explicit release ownership.

Pipeline schema version 2 round-trips artifact references, version 1 and unversioned fixtures remain readable, invalid artifact metadata fails closed, and deserialization does not invoke the resolver or execute a Tool.

Focused/full smoke, Release build, exact API/analyzer/document gates, commit-fixed packages, isolated package consumer/native-copy checks, and exact remote CI pass with reusable evidence and updated current documentation.

evidence.observation: Release build passed with 0 warnings/errors; Pipeline-focused Smoke passed 11/11; full Smoke passed 237/237; all five coverage floors, the exact 3,350-entry API, 411-diagnostic analyzer contract, third-party provenance, and 96 local documentation targets passed.

Five packages at version 3.0.1-pl0015.2e16c7e.1 passed clean-worktree provenance for exact implementation commit 2e16c7ecb0fa1928b37acf4221061cadd46a4258; four package-mutation probes also failed closed.

The isolated package-only consumer restored from a fresh D-drive cache and executed the 2D descriptors/factories/model resolver plus existing 2D/3D contracts; exactly one root OpenCvSharpExtern.dll matched the reviewed SHA-256.

GitHub Actions Build run 34864055796 passed every build, Smoke/coverage, API, analyzer, pack/provenance, negative-probe, isolated-consumer, and native-copy step for exact commit 2e16c7ecb0fa1928b37acf4221061cadd46a4258.

The validation summary binds all five clean-worktree package hashes and provenance at version 3.0.1-pl0015.2e16c7e.1 to the exact implementation commit and separately records all four local mutation probes as fail-closed.

events.summary: Reuse VisionPipelineToolFactory as the Vision2D owner, add a Blob-package composite factory, represent model inputs as host-resolved encoded bytes, and freeze version 1 while introducing schema version 2.
All PL-0015 acceptance criteria passed at the exact implementation commit; package publication and production qualification remain outside this issue.
